notes: Corrected one unit: the comparative `מִן` takes the whole *than at*, headed on *than* (rules 24, 30). The accepted alignment gave *at* to `רִאשֹׁתֵיכֶם` under rule 33, but that rule licenses a function word only for an adverbial accusative, and this noun stands as the object of the preposition.
The italic *unto you* remains `added`: `הֵטִבֹתִי` writes no object in the Hebrew, so the preposition is not one supplied to reach a written object (rule 44).
